verdict.rationale: The API exposes a broad surface that mirrors much of what users do in ChatGPT and the dashboard: text generation 'as you might using ChatGPT', web search and file tools, image generation and editing, voice, fine-tuning, evals, batch and agents. However, no documentation claims full UI–API parity, and some actions appear dashboard-only, such as API key creation and key-lifetime enforcement in Platform settings. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee, evidence that admin/dashboard settings (key management, org policies) are API-accessible, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths 404), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
